  WHY: Two reviewers flagged the messaging as inconsistent, while others said the messages are context-specific and intentional.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:62-65 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: Explicit `VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES=false` now fails immediately without any migration warning or guidance.
  WHY: Existing workflows that still set `false` will break with no clear path to update their configuration.
